search_methods.search_methods: The complete search strategy is available in Supplementary material 1. Electronic searches The Information Specialist searched the Cochrane MS and Rare Diseases of the CNS System's Trials Register (https:// ms.cochrane.org/) up to 3 February 2025. This register includes records from the following sources. •Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL; Issue 1, 2025) in the Cochrane Library. •MEDLINE (PubMed; 1966 to 3 February 2025). •Embase (Embase.com; 1974 to 3 February 2025). •CINAHL (EBSCOhost; 1981 to 3 February 2025). •Latin American and Caribbean Health Science Information Database (LILACS; Bireme; 1982 to 3 February 2025). •WHO International Clinical Trial Registry Platform (ICTRP; apps.who.int/trial search). •US National Institutes of Health Ongoing Trials Register ClinicalTrials.gov (https://clinicaltrials.gov/). Searching other resources We used the following additional methods. •Checked reference lists of relevant reviews and included articles. •Contacted trial authors and experts for missing or unpublished data. •Searched conference reports on neurology, MS societies (https://www.nationalmssociety.org/), and congresses organised by the European Committee for Treatment and Research in MS (https://2022.ectrims-congress.eu/), and by the American Committee for Treatment and Research in MS (https:// www.actrims.org/). •Contacted biotechnology companies for published or unpublished studies. •Searched for postpublication amendments or corrections to eligible studies, by reviewing prior Cochrane reviews, PubMed/ Scopus/Web of Science, journal websites, CrossMark, ORCID, and trial registries; maintained alerts and dated logs of findings.
